## Perspective Audit Summary

**Component/artifact reviewed:** Interactive Map With Mouse-Only Navigation (`MapInterface`)
**Perspectives escalated for deep review:** Magnification & Reflow, Keyboard & Motor Access, Screen Reader & Semantic Structure
**Perspectives at LOW (not reviewed):** Environmental Contrast, Vestibular & Motion Sensitivity, Auditory Access, Cognitive & Neurodivergent

---

### Findings by Severity

| Severity | Count |
|---|---|
| CRITICAL | 3 |
| MAJOR | 2 |
| MINOR | 1 |
| ENHANCEMENT | 0 |

---

### Perspectives That Passed

None — all three escalated perspectives have findings.

---

### Findings by ARRM Role

#### Front-End Dev

- **Finding:** Map container uses `role="application"` which traps keyboard focus and disables standard screen reader navigation; no keyboard alternative for mouse-drag panning
  - **WCAG:** 2.1.1 Keyboard, 4.1.2 Name/Role/Value
  - **Perspective:** Screen Reader & Semantic Structure / Keyboard & Motor Access
  - **Severity:** CRITICAL
  - **Route to:** Front-End Dev (primary), UX Design (secondary)
  - **Evidence:** `MapInterface.jsx:35` — `<div role="application" ...>` with no keyboard handlers; panning only via `onMouseDown`/`onMouseMove`/`onMouseUp`

- **Finding:** Marker popups triggered exclusively by mouse hover (`onMouseEnter`/`onMouseLeave`) with no keyboard equivalent
  - **WCAG:** 2.1.1 Keyboard, 4.1.3 Status Messages
  - **Perspective:** Screen Reader & Semantic Structure / Keyboard & Motor Access
  - **Severity:** CRITICAL
  - **Route to:** Front-End Dev (primary), UX Design (secondary)
  - **Evidence:** `MapInterface.jsx:56-59` — popups only appear on mouse hover; no focus or click handlers

- **Finding:** Zoom controls are real `<button>` elements but lack visible focus indicator styling for non-keyboard users and rely solely on `:focus-visible` which may not trigger in all contexts
  - **WCAG:** 2.4.7 Focus Visible, 2.5.8 Target Size
  - **Perspective:** Keyboard & Motor Access
  - **Severity:** MINOR
  - **Route to:** Front-End Dev (primary), Visual Design (secondary)
  - **Evidence:** `MapInterface.css:69` — `.zoom-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #005fcc; }` only applies with `:focus-visible`, not guaranteed for all keyboard users

- **Finding:** Map canvas has fixed dimensions (`width: 600px`) that prevent proper reflow at narrow viewports
  - **WCAG:** 1.4.10 Reflow, 1.4.4 Resize Text
  - **Perspective:** Magnification & Reflow
  - **Severity:** MAJOR
  - **Route to:** Front-End Dev (primary), Visual Design (secondary)
  - **Evidence:** `MapInterface.css:39` — `.map-canvas { width: 600px; height: 400px; }` causes horizontal overflow at <600px viewport

#### UX Design

- **Finding:** No keyboard-accessible alternative for mouse-drag map panning (arrow keys, WASD)
  - **WCAG:** 2.1.1 Keyboard, 2.5.7 Dragging Movements
  - **Perspective:** Keyboard & Motor Access
  - **Severity:** CRITICAL
  - **Route to:** UX Design (primary), Front-End Dev (secondary)
  - **Evidence:** `MapInterface.jsx:35-40` — only mouse event handlers (`onMouseDown`, `onMouseMove`) for panning; no keyboard equivalent

- **Finding:** No skip link or mechanism to bypass the map interface for keyboard users navigating page content
  - **WCAG:** 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks, 2.4.3 Focus Order
  - **Perspective:** Keyboard & Motor Access / Screen Reader & Semantic Structure
  - **Severity:** MAJOR
  - **Route to:** UX Design (primary), Front-End Dev (secondary)
  - **Evidence:** `MapInterface.jsx:30-68` — no skip link present; focus order enters map container with `role="application"` and cannot easily exit

#### Content Author

No findings routed to this role.

---

### Open Questions Requiring Human Verification

None identified in source code review. All findings are code-level and enforceable from source.

---

### Recommended Next Step

**BLOCK** — Three CRITICAL findings prevent accessible use of the map component:
1. `role="application"` traps keyboard users with no escape mechanism
2. Marker popups inaccessible via keyboard (mouse-hover only)
3. No keyboard alternative for mouse-drag panning

The component must be revised to provide full keyboard access before shipping. Recommended actions include removing `role="application"`, adding arrow-key navigation, implementing focus-based popup triggers, and providing a skip link.
